name: John Dunn Bridge
facts: John Dunn rebuilt the bridge in 1908 after a fire, and he ran a hotel and daily mail service, charging a $1 toll per person.
In 1912 the bridge was sold to the Territory of New Mexico, which removed the toll and opened it to all travelers.
The bridge marks the northern end of the 18‑mile "Taos Box" whitewater rafting run on the Rio Grande, and a short drive away lies the natural Black Rock Hot Springs.
